name: warming up in lunge (two)
description: Lunge warm-up, part 2: from a low lunge, reach one arm overhead to lengthen one side of the torso and the rear hip.
instructions: Step into a low lunge with the rear knee resting on padding.
Keep the front foot firmly planted and reach one arm up while the other arm hangs comfortably by your side.
Lift through the reaching side of your torso and gently shift your hips forward without arching your lower back.
Lower the arm, change legs and reaching arm, then repeat.
